name: @mountainpass/addressr-deployment
description: Terraform + Elastic Beanstalk + Cloudflare deployment of the Addressr production service
//: Private on purpose: changeset publish skips it while changeset version still bumps it, which is what lets a changeset here arm a deploy without publishing anything. A changeset naming this package IS the arming declaration for a production Terraform apply (ADR-045) — merging the resulting release PR is the apply. The dependency below is NOT read at deploy time: deploy.sh writes its own manifest from resolve-version.sh, so this pin exists only to make an app changeset cascade a bump into this package. Loosening it to a range, * or workspace: silently stops infrastructure changes deploying, on a green run; pinned by test/js/__tests__/deployment-cascade-pin.test.mjs. CORRECTED 2026-08-10: this note used to end "until the release.yml deploy gate is repointed at this package version bump, a changeset here versions the package and applies NOTHING" — the gate was repointed at 8199e5b9, so that sentence told a reader the exact opposite of the truth about production arming.
